prompt: It is important for everyone, including Young people, to Save money for their future. TO what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
It is argued that it is crucial for everyone , including teenagers , to save money for the future. I strongly agree with this statement because I think that the sooner we can save money, the wealthier we will be in the future. We never know what is going to happen in the future. But the only thing we can do is to be prepared for it by saving money.

If people save money, they can grow it by investing. These investments allow people to prepare themselves for the future. Humans cannot predict the future , but they can do things, like saving money, that are going to make it easier. People can invest  this money so that it produced compounds interests. For example, a teenager who keeps money from christmas gift can save it. As a result, this money can be invested so that in twenty years, the money has grown to twenty per cent. In consequence, these young people can afford a good university that requires a big amount of money.

Financial education is a crucial part to enter in the adult world. Young people who experiment with money management are prepared for the future. Saving money is part of the education that can be missed in high school. For instance, people who keep money in a bank  will be able to manage their own money in the future because they have experienced it before. They will know how to create a savings account. Moreover, keeping money is a financial rescue in case of an economic crisis. In those types of crises, a lot of people can lose their jobs, and even more their houses. But the ones who have saved money are the ones who will first recover.

To conclude, saving money can have multiple benefits. First, because it can be invested in and can create more money for people to afford housing. And secondly, because it participated in the education needed to enter the adult world. I wholeheartedly agree with this opinion, because my parents always told me to do so.
